name: Industrial Brand
tagline: One mark, a hundred surfaces, cut on the beat.
description: Identity-system film for heavy, physical brands: vermilion, near-black and concrete, the mark stamped onto real applications (cladding, webbing straps, container steel, labels, construction drawings), cut as a rhythmic 4–5-frame montage that lands on a long, still hold. The edit is the animation; the mark is the continuity.

signature: rhythmic hard-cut montage: a new still application every 4–5 frames on a 16th-note pulse, the mark held in the same zone of frame
the montage lands on a long, still hold where only hairlines draw and labels type on
colour-block cut: orange field → black panel → concrete, the block edges aligned across shots

camera: Locked off. Applications are stills shot square-on or from below (architecture), extreme crops; the edit carries the motion. Inside a hold at most a 1–2 % creep.

texture.notes: Matte print and real materials: corrugated steel, webbing with stitched edges, raw concrete, overcast daylight. Fine static grain; no glow, no gloss.

lighting: Hard raking daylight from one side, deep matte shadows; overcast sky on architecture; never studio-glossy.
sound: A dry 110–120 BPM pulse with a hit on every cut (mechanical clacks, ratchet ticks, a shutter); the hold drops to a low drone and one heavy thud when the mark lands.

beats.label: Orange panel, cladding, drawing: the mark holds its zone
Lands on the hold: the drawing draws, the block wipes in
Caption types, hold, cut back to the panel

motionSummary: Moves like a stamping press: a hard-cut montage of applications every 4–5 frames with the mark locked in one zone, then a dead-still hold where the construction drawing draws itself and a colour block slams in.

composition: the mark owns one zone of frame (centre) at a near-constant size in every shot; the world changes around it
extreme crops of real applications shot square-on or from below; nothing floats
colour blocks on one shared grid so block edges align across cuts
frame furniture on every shot: edge-rotated mono captions and an index (APP. 07 / 20)
visual.shapeLanguage: hard rectangles, columns and thirds; the mark's stem-block-slab geometry; 1 px construction hairlines and circles; no radii, no soft shapes
visual.contrast: maximal and flat: vermilion as a material against near-black and concrete; no gradients-as-decoration, no glow

grammar.pacing: two speeds only: a montage at the pulse (a new still every 4–5 frames for 2–3 s) and a dead-still hold (1.5–2 s); nothing in between
grammar.rhythm: mechanical, beat-cut on a 16th-note pulse (5/4/5/4 frames ≈ 115 BPM); hard steps(1) cuts, never eased
grammar.easing: cuts have no ease; inside a hold, drafting moves use ease.move (hairlines draw), colour blocks ease.enter (6–8 frames, no overshoot), the stamp spring is critically damped
grammar.acceleration: instant: a cut is 0 frames; drafting accelerates hard and stops dead like a plotter; the only slow thing is a 1–2 % creep across a hold
movement: hard-cut montage of stills (the edit is the animation)
hairlines and circles drawing on around the mark
colour block sliding in along the grid
mono captions typing on character by character
re-crop of the same application as a push (no camera)
grammar.density: inside a montage shot: zero moving parts; inside a hold: one drafting process at a time
grammar.holds: the montage always lands on a long still hold where the mark sits and only drafting moves; the hold is where the brand is read

transitionPresets.name: Match cut on the mark
transitionPresets.bridge: the mark, same position and size in both shots
transitionPresets.build: hard cut on the pulse; the surface under the mark changes (steel → webbing → cladding), the mark itself does not move, so the cut is invisible on the mark and loud everywhere else
transitionPresets.sound: one mechanical hit per cut (ratchet tick, latch, shutter)

transitionPresets.name: Pulse montage
transitionPresets.bridge: the beat grid and the mark's zone
transitionPresets.build: a string of still applications alternating 5 and 4 frames on a 16th-note pulse for 2–3 s; tones alternate light/dark so every cut reads
transitionPresets.sound: 16th-note clacks on a dry 110–120 BPM loop

transitionPresets.name: Land on the hold
transitionPresets.bridge: the mark, which stays put while the montage stops
transitionPresets.build: the last montage cut lands on a downbeat and everything freezes; on the next beat the construction drawing starts drawing around the mark
transitionPresets.sound: the pulse drops out; one heavy thud as the mark lands, a low drone under the hold

transitionPresets.name: Colour-block wipe
transitionPresets.bridge: a grid line of the drawing
transitionPresets.build: an orange column (and a black base) slides in from the frame edge along a grid line, edge-aligned, and frames the wordmark
transitionPresets.sound: a dry slide and a latch on arrival

transitionPresets.name: Re-crop push
transitionPresets.build: hard cut to a tighter crop of the same still (facade → facade tight, container → rivet row); the push is in the edit, not the camera

transitionPresets.name: Construction zoom
transitionPresets.bridge: the construction circle around the mark
transitionPresets.build: fixed-point zoom into the drawing's circle until it lands on a real application of the mark at the same size (drawing → cladding)
transitionPresets.sound: a short mechanical wind-up into a clack

archetypes.name: Application still
archetypes.purpose: prove the mark survives a real surface
archetypes.composition: one extremely cropped application (container side, webbing strap, cladding from below, cargo label), the mark in its zone, edge captions and index
archetypes.elements: the mark, the material, one mono caption
archetypes.motion: none inside the shot; it lasts 4–5 frames

archetypes.name: Colour-block field
archetypes.composition: orange field with an inset black panel, or thirds orange / black / concrete with hex labels; the mark in its zone
archetypes.elements: flat blocks, the mark, the wordmark small at a block edge
archetypes.motion: none in the montage; as an opener it holds 1 s

archetypes.name: Cropped letterform
archetypes.purpose: show the typeface as an object
archetypes.composition: one lowercase letter of the wordmark at 1500 px+, bleeding off two edges, the mark small in its zone
archetypes.elements: the letter, the mark, a type caption

archetypes.name: Construction hold
archetypes.composition: concrete ground, the mark solid in its zone, grid lines through its edges, circles and dimension ticks in the accent
archetypes.elements: hairlines, circles, dimension labels (100 U, R 18, 22.6°), LOGOMARK CONSTRUCTION caption
archetypes.motion: hairlines draw on in a stagger (ease.move), labels appear on the beat, 1–2 % creep

archetypes.name: System lockup
archetypes.composition: the drawing on the left, an orange column with a black base on the right grid line; the wordmark sits on the black base, the descriptor at the top of the column
archetypes.elements: wordmark, mono descriptor typed on, symbol / grid caption
archetypes.motion: block wipes in, descriptor types character by character, then nothing

beats.purpose: the palette and the mark, flat and loud
beats.motion: one colour-block field holds a beat; the mark is already in its zone
a still every 4–5 frames, light/dark alternating, the mark never leaves its zone
dead still; the construction drawing draws itself, labels land on beats
a second, shorter montage of tighter re-crops on the same pulse
the colour block wipes in on the grid, the descriptor types, hold to the end

sequence.cutRhythm: hard cuts only, on a 16th-note pulse: 5/4/5/4 frames (≈115 BPM) for 2–3 s, then a 1.5–2 s still hold; a cut never falls off the pulse and never dissolves

scenes.action: orange field, black panel, the halden mark lands in its zone with a thud; HEAVY CARGO & TERMINAL SERVICES in mono
30 stills at 5/4 frames: cladding, strap at −32°, container steel, giant 'h', cargo label, strap at +24°, thirds with hex codes; index counts APP. 01 → 20
everything stops; grid lines and circles draw around the mark, 100 U / R 18 / 22.6° land on beats
zoom through the construction circle onto the facade; a tighter burst of re-crops (facade tight, rivet row, 'd' on black)
orange column slides in on the grid, black base, 'halden' sits on it, descriptor types; hold 2 s

elements.text: lowercase heavy wordmark that never animates in (it is stamped, present on the cut); mono uppercase captions type on character by character only inside holds; edge captions rotated 90°
elements.logo: the mark is the continuity: same zone, near-same size across every cut; it never moves, scales or spins inside a shot; it lands with a critically damped stamp at most
elements.icons: none; pictograms only as construction diagrams or stencil marks on materials
elements.images: still photographs or renders of real applications (steel, webbing, cladding, labels), desaturated so orange is loudest; each lasts 4–5 frames
elements.ui: none; if a screen appears it is just another application still
elements.shapes: colour blocks on the grid (columns, thirds, inset panels) that wipe in edge-aligned; hairline circles and dimension ticks that draw on
elements.background: flat colour fields or the material itself; concrete for holds; never a gradient wash

audio.sync: every cut on a 16th note of a dry 110–120 BPM pulse; the hold starts on a downbeat where the pulse drops out; the mark's landing gets one heavy thud
audio.sfx: ratchet ticks, latches, shutter clicks, a dry slide for block wipes, a low drone under holds, one heavy thud
